newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary cenbank says cuts base rate to 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary cenbank says cuts base rate to 21 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Tuesday it would reduce the base rate to an annual 21 percent from an annual 21.50 percent, effective July 1.

The central bank added in a statement that interest rate on refinancing loans of over one-year maturity, provided to financial institutions, as well as forint interest rates on project financing loans, given on the collateral of hard currency deposits, are also being reduced to an annual 21 percent from 21.50 percent.
The interest rate on the so-called Start and Japanese refinancing loans - which are always 75 percent of the base rate - is reduced to an annual 15.75 percent from 16.125 percent, it said.
